description: This file contains helper functions for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer, including functions for SQL manipulation, query execution, and debugging.

methods.name: adodb_strip_order_by
methods.description: Removes the ORDER BY clause from an SQL SELECT statement.

methods.name: adodb_probetypes
methods.description: Guesses data types for array data based on sample values.

methods.name: adodb_transpose
methods.description: Transposes a 2D array, optionally creating headers.

methods.name: adodb_replace
methods.description: Performs an UPSERT operation (update or insert) on a database table.

methods.name: adodb_getmenu
methods.description: Generates HTML select options from a database query.

methods.name: adodb_getmenu_gp
methods.description: Generates grouped HTML select options from a database query.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_select
methods.description: Creates the opening <select> HTML tag with options.

methods.name: _adodb_getmenu_option
methods.description: Generates an HTML option tag, marking it as selected if applicable.

methods.name: _adodb_getcount
methods.description: Returns the count of records a SQL query would return, using query rewriting heuristics.

methods.name: _adodb_pageexecute_all_rows
methods.description: Executes a paginated query and returns a recordset with pagination info.

methods.name: _adodb_pageexecute_no_last_page
methods.description: Executes a paginated query without last page info, with lookahead.

methods.name: _adodb_quote_fieldname
methods.description: Converts and quotes a database field name according to global settings.

methods.name: _adodb_getupdatesql
methods.description: Generates an UPDATE SQL statement based on recordset differences.

methods.name: adodb_key_exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in an array, with optional strictness.

methods.name: _adodb_getinsertsql
methods.description: Generates an INSERT SQL statement from a recordset or table name.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql_oci8
methods.description: Handles BLOB and long data types for Oracle OCI8 driver during SQL generation.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql
methods.description: Generates SQL for a column based on its type and database provider.

methods.name: _adodb_column_sql_oci8
methods.description: Handles Oracle OCI8 specific column SQL generation.

methods.name: _adodb_debug_execute
methods.description: Debug wrapper for executing SQL queries, with output formatting.

methods.name: _adodb_backtrace
methods.description: Outputs a formatted PHP debug backtrace for debugging purposes.
